name: What is the process for installing ceiling molding?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for installing ceiling molding?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our installation process begins with an initial consultation and measurement to determine material needs and design preferences. We then prepare the work area, ensuring surfaces are clean and protected. The molding is cut precisely, often using miter saws for accurate corner joints, and then securely fastened to the ceiling and wall. After installation, all seams, nail holes, and imperfections are filled and sanded for a smooth finish, ready for painting. Understanding the sequence from measurement to finishing helps set expectations for your project.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, material preparation, precise cutting and fastening, followed by finishing and sanding to prepare for paint.
